Sliding-window mean and variance estimates for tagged data using bins and EMA.

# Purpose
This header defines `fd_est_tbl`, a tagged estimation table that stores approximate sliding-window mean and variance values for recent `uint` inputs. It uses a fixed number of bins, selected by hashing a `tag` with a bit mask, so different tags can alias to the same bin and share statistics. The file provides inline functions to get the required alignment and footprint, create and destroy the table in caller-owned memory, join and leave the memory region, update the table with a new tagged value, and estimate mean and variance for a tag. The implementation is enabled only when `FD_HAS_DOUBLE` is set, and it uses exponential moving averages to decay older data over time.
